cape.alyrioncore.2_year_celebration.name: 2 Year Celebration Cape
cape.alyrioncore.2_year_celebration.desc: Commemorating 2 years of Alyrion with a festive cake!
cape.alyrioncore.season_8.name: Season 8 Cape
cape.alyrioncore.season_8.desc: Exclusive crimson & gold cape celebrating Season 8!
cape.alyrioncore.stars.name: Stars Cape
cape.alyrioncore.stars.desc: Deep space starry sky with an orbiting research satellite.
cape.alyrioncore.moon.name: Moon Cape
cape.alyrioncore.moon.desc: Lunar surface overlooking planet Earth in deep space.
cape.alyrioncore.marsian.name: The Martian Cape
cape.alyrioncore.marsian.desc: Rust-ochre Martian dunes under the red planet, with a little green Martian.
cape.alyrioncore.grim.name: Grim Cape
cape.alyrioncore.grim.desc: A black cape bearing a bleached skull, earned with 10 coins or 10 player kills.
cape.alyrioncore.pride.name: Pride Cape
cape.alyrioncore.pride.desc: The Progress Pride flag: rainbow stripes behind the trans chevron, earned by partying up with at least 4 players (Open Parties and Claims).
cape.alyrioncore.chicken.name: Chicken Cape
cape.alyrioncore.chicken.desc: A lively green cape sporting a clucking chicken face, earned by hatching an egg or for 5 coins.
cape.alyrioncore.trans_pride.name: Trans Pride Cape
cape.alyrioncore.trans_pride.desc: Pastel blue, pink, and white stripes of the Transgender Pride flag, earned by collecting each vanilla dye or for 5 coins.
cape.alyrioncore.communism.name: Communism Cape
cape.alyrioncore.communism.desc: A bold red cape emblazoned with the golden hammer and sickle, earned by repairing an item in an anvil or for 5 coins.
cape.alyrioncore.ender.name: End Cape
cape.alyrioncore.ender.desc: A deep violet void cape adorned with an Ender Dragon crest, earned by obtaining the Dragon Egg.
cape.alyrioncore.wither.name: Wither Cape
cape.alyrioncore.wither.desc: A dark, tattered ash cloak bearing the skeletal visage of the Wither, earned by slaying the Wither.
cape.alyrioncore.creeper.name: Red Creeper Cape
cape.alyrioncore.creeper.desc: A jet-black cape bearing an ominous crimson Creeper face, earned by dying 100 times.
cape.alyrioncore.zombie_villager.name: Zombie Villager Cape
cape.alyrioncore.zombie_villager.desc: A split-faced cape depicting the triumph of curing a Zombie Villager.
cape.alyrioncore.overload.name: Overload Cape
cape.alyrioncore.overload.desc: A glitched black and magenta missing-texture cape for those who shattered the bank with 1,000 coins.
cape.alyrioncore.palestine.name: Palestine Cape
cape.alyrioncore.palestine.desc: A vibrant red, black, white, and green flag cape. Grants a +10% (1.1x) playtime coin multiplier while equipped!
trail.alyrioncore.rocket_trail.name: Rocket Trail
trail.alyrioncore.rocket_trail.desc: Leave a fiery rocket exhaust trail behind you as you run!
task.alyrioncore.task_space.title: Going to Space
task.alyrioncore.task_space.desc: Launch into Space or Orbit (Cosmonautics / Orbit).
task.alyrioncore.task_moon.title: Going to the Moon
task.alyrioncore.task_moon.desc: Touch down on the lunar surface (Cosmonautics Moon).
task.alyrioncore.task_mars.title: Going to Mars
task.alyrioncore.task_mars.desc: Touch down on the red Martian surface.
task.alyrioncore.task_dragon_egg.title: Obtaining the Dragon Egg
task.alyrioncore.task_dragon_egg.desc: Slay the Ender Dragon and hold the Dragon Egg in your inventory.
task.alyrioncore.task_kills.title: Grim Reaper
task.alyrioncore.task_party.title: United We Stand
task.alyrioncore.task_party.desc: Be a member of a party with at least 4 players (Open Parties and Claims).
task.alyrioncore.task_travel_10k.title: Wanderer (10k Blocks)
task.alyrioncore.task_travel_100k.title: Explorer (100k Blocks)
task.alyrioncore.task_travel_100k.desc: Travel 100,000 blocks across the world (requires Wanderer task).
task.alyrioncore.task_travel_1m.title: Globetrotter (1M Blocks)
task.alyrioncore.task_travel_1m.desc: Travel 1,000,000 blocks across the world (requires Explorer task).
task.alyrioncore.task_chicken.title: Egg Hatching
task.alyrioncore.task_chicken.desc: Spawn a chicken by throwing eggs.
task.alyrioncore.task_trans_pride.title: True Colors
task.alyrioncore.task_communism.title: Hammer and Sickle
task.alyrioncore.task_communism.desc: Repair an item in an anvil.
task.alyrioncore.task_martian_potato.des: Harvest a mature Martian Potato inside a sealed habitat.
task.alyrioncore.task_life_support.title: Life Support
task.alyrioncore.task_life_support.desc: Stand inside a fully sealed and oxygenated habitat.
task.alyrioncore.task_weather_storm.desc: Sleep through a global Martian dust storm in a Sleeping Pod.
task.alyrioncore.task_probe_salvager.des: Loot a crashed probe on the Martian surface.
task.alyrioncore.task_netherite_reinforc: Reinforce a block with a Netherite Reinforcement Plate.
task.alyrioncore.task_strider_tour.title: Lava Ferry
task.alyrioncore.task_strider_tour.desc: Ride a Strider over lava for at least 1,000 blocks.
task.alyrioncore.task_relic_hunter.title: Relic Hunter
task.alyrioncore.task_relic_hunter.desc: Discover a Decorated Pot Sherd or Sniffer Egg through archaeology.
task.alyrioncore.task_wither_slayer.desc: Defeat the Wither in mortal combat.
task.alyrioncore.task_mach_speed.title: Mach Speed
task.alyrioncore.task_mach_speed.desc: Reach a horizontal flight speed of 40 m/s with Elytra.
task.alyrioncore.task_cure_villager.desc: Cure a Zombie Villager back into a normal villager.
task.alyrioncore.task_coin_overload.desc: Amass a fortune of 1,000 Alyrion Coins.
task.alyrioncore.task_death_100.title: Century of Demise
task.alyrioncore.task_mine_10k.title: Master Miner (10k Blocks)
task.alyrioncore.task_all_ores.title: Master Prospector
task.alyrioncore.task_all_ores.desc: Obtain every vanilla ore (Coal, Iron, Copper, Gold, Redstone, Emerald, Lapis, Diamond, Nether Quartz, Ancient Debris).
task.alyrioncore.task_diamonds_64.title: Diamond Hoarder
